Here we compare the different models for the same sampling approach

```{r,echo=FALSE,include=FALSE}
source('../scripts/fitBPOT.R')
source('../scripts/fitCBPOT.R')
source('../scripts/fitBPOT_joint.R')
```

# BPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
summarise_bpot(all_bpot_results,severity_thresholds = c(20,30,40,50),
               severity = pis0,x0=x0, severity_age = pis1,age_mean = 45)
plot_crash_severity(lapply(all_bpot_results, function(x) x$plot_df),
                    filename = "crash_severity_BPOT.png")
```


# CBPOT
```{r,echo=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
summarise_cbpot(all_cbpot_results,severity_thresholds = c(20,30,40,50),x0=x0,severity = pis0)
plot_crash_severity(lapply(all_cbpot_results, function(x) x$plot_df_q),
                    filename = "crash_severity_CBPOT.png")
```
